brief:
Iran will not abandon its commitment to supporting Palestine and resistance movements regardless of international pressure, Brigadier General Ismail Qaani, commander of the Quds Force in Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps, said on Wednesday, Shehab Wire reported. Qaani emphasized that the question of Al-Aqsa Mosque will remain a permanent priority in Iran's strategic calculations and policies.

The remarks reflect Tehran's position that Palestinian issues form a core element of its regional agenda despite mounting diplomatic and economic tensions with Western powers and their allies in the Middle East.
